description: Prospectively binds only the bounded Engineer surfaces needed to make both complete B6 coverage-profile populations pass inside their original five-second and 90-second budgets. The population, coverage profile, timeouts, argv, authority, output, and registry semantics may not change.

rationale.packages/cli/src/bin.ts: Route from the canonical candidate registry before lazily loading only the selected handler group while retaining full help and format semantics.
rationale.packages/cli/src/command-router.ts: Read the already-public sensor registry through a lightweight subpath without eagerly loading unrelated sensor implementation.
rationale.packages/cli/src/commands/sense/facade.t: Read the sensor registry and preset policy through lightweight subpaths without changing either population.
rationale.packages/cli/src/commands/sense/inventor: Read inventory-slice policy through its lightweight subpath without changing slice membership or execution.
rationale.packages/sensors/package.json: Expose only the existing registry and preset policy as lightweight package subpaths.
rationale.packages/loop/src/inventory/walker.ts: Provide one invocation-scoped read snapshot shared by the complete inventory extraction.
rationale.packages/loop/src/inventory/ts-ast.ts: Reuse parsed source state only inside the invocation-scoped inventory snapshot.
rationale.packages/loop/src/inventory/glossary-cov: Read each glossary source once per invocation while preserving every emitted member and diagnostic.

forbidden: registry, authority, argv, output, help, or coverage semantic changes
any implementation path outside this exact eight-path set
